Add scale bars

Source: R/annotations.R
add_scale_bar.Rd

Adds a scale bar to the panels of a montage. Panels of one view share the same magnification (see add_crop()), so by default one bar per view is drawn, in the bottom-right panel of that view.

Usage

add_scale_bar(
  montage,
  length = NULL,
  where = c("last", "all", "merge"),
  position = c("bottomright", "bottomleft", "topright", "topleft"),
  color = "white",
  outline = "black",
  label = TRUE,
  size = 7,
  thickness = 0.6,
  inset = 1.5
)

Arguments

montage

A tidymontage() object.

length

Length of the bar in micrometres: a single number for all views, a named vector per view (e.g. c(crop = 10, zoom = 2)), or NULL to choose a round length of about a fifth of the panel width.

where

Which panels get a bar: "last" (one per view), "all", or "merge" (all merge panels).

position

Corner of the panel.

color

Colour of the bar and its label.

outline

Colour of a thin border around the bar and a halo around the label, which keeps them visible on bright image content. NA for none.

label

Show the length above the bar?

size

Text size in points.

thickness

Thickness of the bar in mm.

inset

Distance from the panel edges in mm.

Value

The montage with the scale bar step added.

Details

Scale bars need a known pixel size. If the images of a view have different magnifications, for example uncropped images with different pixel sizes, every panel of that view gets its own bar.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
montage |> add_scale_bar(10)
montage |> add_scale_bar(c(crop = 10, zoom = 2), where = "all")
} # }
